notes:
MIG-0016. Change scripts drop the eight null-only amount columns (subs_amount, fee_amount, invoiced_subtotal, credited_amount, currency_id, fee_amount_gbp, credited_amount_gbp, net_amount_gbp) from silv_membership_events and fact_membership_events; the down script adds them back as MOD-007 built them. usp_load_silv_membership_events_segments: keys and carried flags from silv_member_year_attributes for the event's segment Campaign Year (own year; a Join uses MIN(campaign_year) in silv_payment_events for its contact, else its own year, the same rule as silv_event_amount.amount_campaign_year), 0 where there is no row; amounts and amount_status from silv_event_amount by event_nk for Join/Renewal/Readmission, null otherwise (including an event with no amount row, which clears stale values). usp_load_fact_membership_events_segments copies the nine columns by event_id and runs the silver-to-gold check (counts by payment_method_id, counts by amount_status, sums of both GBP amounts) inside the transaction; a mismatch throws 50001, logs Failed and leaves the fact unchanged. Both update only rows that differ (amount_status compared as bytes, so a case-only change lands) and log via the Phase 1 usp_etl_log_start/usp_etl_log_end with 0 inserted and 0 deleted. No Phase 1 column, row or procedure is changed. No grants: the module adds no object a reporting role reads.

Test-first: the first run had 26 of 26 of the Tester's tests passing; the final run passed 26 of 26 and 6 unit test(s), in 1 run(s).
